method: Deep-research replay derived from the already-frozen 2022Q1 event set. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff regime snapshots are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No selected-stock post-cutoff returns are opened before deep memos lock.
V1.2 expectation paths are frozen from contemporaneous forecasts rather than reconstructed from later earnings.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
